zh.title: 西南航空於波特蘭機場（PDX）涉種族歧視遭索賠120萬美元
zh.summary: 西南航空於波特蘭機場涉嫌種族歧視事件，遭求償120萬美元。
body: 美國西南航空（Southwest Airlines）在波特蘭國際機場發生的一起涉嫌種族歧視事件中面臨法律訴訟。根據 Simple Flying 的報導，相關原告針對該起事件向西南航空提出了總額達 120 萬美元的賠償要求。
據報導說明，該起事件發生於航班起飛前，事發時在登機門區域出現大聲指控，並伴隨涉及兒童監護權的虛假喊叫聲。這起指控事件導致一個來自波特蘭的家庭在登機前受到極大尊嚴損害與羞辱。
目前這起針對西南航空在波特蘭國際機場發生的涉嫌種族歧視訴訟已提出，索賠金額為 120 萬美元。

en.title: Southwest Airlines Sued for $1.2M Over Alleged Discrimination at PDX (PDX)
en.summary: Southwest Airlines faces a $1.2 million lawsuit over alleged racial discrimination at Portland Airport.
body: Southwest Airlines is facing a $1.2 million lawsuit following an alleged racial discrimination incident at Portland International Airport , according to a report published by Simple Flying.

The legal complaint concerns an event that took place prior to departure at the airport gate. According to the reported details, loud gate accusations and a claimed false custody shout occurred during the interaction, which reportedly left a Portland family humiliated before departure.
The filed lawsuit seeks $1.2 million in total damages from Southwest Airlines in connection with the alleged racial discrimination incident at Portland International Airport .
